verdict.rationale: The pack never documents retention policies, TTLs or delete operations. The only indirect support is that HelixDB can run embedded or locally, in memory, on disk or on object storage, with Cloud login optional. That leaves the user in control of where data lives and how long it persists. missing for 10: documented delete/purge query operations, retention or TTL policies, database or data deletion commands in the CLI/Cloud, Cloud data-retention and deletion guarantees, independent corroboration.
